rationale: C16 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template for the child. Both are periodic reports on the same Iran national emergency and share a highly specific framework: an opening identifying the same two emergency directives and statutory reporting authorities; discussion of the Iranian Transactions Regulations, licensing of pre-embargo Iranian carpets, Customs seizures, and enforcement; numbered updates on the Iran-United States Claims Tribunal, large and small claims, government-to-government claims, Security Account replenishments, and Bank Markazi payments; and an almost verbatim concluding assessment of the Iranian Assets Control Regulations and Iranian Transactions Regulations. C05 and C22 are earlier Iran-report templates with parallel Tribunal and claims sections, but they lack C16's later dual-regulation framework and are less textually close.

shared_material.child_excerpt: This report is submitted pursuant to Section 204(c) of the International Emergency Economic Powers Act... and Section 505(c) of the International Security and Development Cooperation Act of 1985...
shared_material.parent_excerpt: This report with respect to Iran is made pursuant to Section 204(c) of the International Emergency Economic Powers Act... and Section 505(c) of the International Security and Development Cooperation Act of 1985...
shared_material.explanation: The reports invoke the same paired statutory authorities in closely matching opening language.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The major focus of licensing activity under the ITRs remains the importation of certain non-fungible Iranian-origin goods, principally carpets, which were located outside Iran before the embargo was imposed, and where no payment or benefit accrued to Iran after the effective date of the embargo.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Currently, the major focus of licensing activity for FAC relates to the importation of certain non-fungible Iranian-origin goods, principally carpets, which were located outside Iran before the embargo was imposed, and where no payment or benefit accrued to Iran after the effective date of the embargo.
shared_material.explanation: This is distinctive, nearly verbatim language describing the same narrow licensing category.

Similarly, the Iranian Transactions Regulations... continue to advance important objectives in combatting international terrorism.
